description: Source code for STM32F4 microcontroller handling SPI communication, UART, GPIO configuration, and interrupt handling, specifically for a device labeled 'hip9011'.

methods.name: uart_putc
methods.description: Send a character over UART by placing it into the transmit buffer and enabling transmit interrupt.

methods.name: uart_getc
methods.description: Retrieve a character from UART receive buffer, returns NO_DATA if buffer is empty.

methods.name: spi
methods.description: Perform SPI transfer by asserting chip select, sending data, and reading response.
